name: Life Eternal
overview: Scripture reveals that eternal life is intimately connected to Christ, who identifies Himself as the living bread from heaven that grants life to those who partake of Him. Jesus teaches that to have eternal life, one must spiritually eat His flesh and drink His blood, symbolizing a deep, sustaining union with Him. This life is not inherited by works but is given through faith in Christ, who promises resurrection and everlasting life to all who believe.
